name: com.xlx.speech.voicereadsdk.ui.activity.SpeechVoiceMallLandingActivity
description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when a user opens a shopping-ad product landing page. It plays the product video, shows prices and coupons, and opens the linked shop when the user taps buy.
disableEffect: The SDK shopping offer, coupon link, and purchase route will no longer open.
